div.head: II Ew 7
div.ab: Ne underfó nan man oðres mannes man butan þæs leafe ðe he ær fyligde, ⁊ hær he syl laðleas wið ælce hand. Gif hit hwa dó, bete mine oferhyrnesse.
Ne underfo nan man oðres mannes man butan ðæs leafe ðe he ær fylgde, ⁊ ær he sy laðleas wið ælce hand. Gyf hit hwa dó, bete mine oferhyrnysse.
Et non recipiat aliquis alterius hominem sine licentia illius, cui ante seruiuit, priusquam innocens sit apud omnem manum. Si quis hoc secus faciat, emendet ouerhyrnessam meam.
[Be ðone ðe oþres mannes man underfehþ butan leafe.] Ne underfó nan man oðres mannes man butan þæs leafe ðe he ær fyligde ⁊ ær he sy laðleas wið ælce hand. Gif hit hwa dó, bete mine oferhyrnesse.

(Von dem, der den Untergebenen eines anderen Mannes aufnimmt ohne Erlaubniss [des letzteren]. Ld) Niemand nehme den Untergebenen von jemand anders [ins Gefolge] auf ohne Erlaubniss von diesem [letzteren], dem derselbe früher untergeben war, und bevor derselbe gegenüber jeder Person von Verschuldung frei ist. Wenn das einer thut, zahle er als Busse den ‘Ungehorsam’ gegen mich.

(Of him who receives another man's dependant without [the latter's] permission. Ld) No one is to receive the dependant of someone else [into his following] without the permission of this [latter], to whom he was formerly subject, and before he is free of guilt towards every person. If anyone does that, let him pay as compensation the ‘disobedience’ [fine] to me.

No man shall take into his service one who has been in the service of another without the permission of the latter, and until he is free of all charges from any other quarter. If any man does so, he shall pay as compensation the amount due for insubordination to me.

Der Staat verschärft das Verbot gegen Austritt aus dem Gefolge (s. d. 8. 19c. d. 26): bei Af war er nur verboten, wenn mit Grafschaftswechsel verbunden; hier allgemein. Die erste Zeile wiederholt II As 22 = III 4. IV 5. Vgl. Fremde 12a; Bauer 10d. e; Herrensuche 3

The State tightens the prohibition against leaving the following (see that word 8. 19c. d. 26): in Af it was forbidden only when combined with a change of shire; here it is forbidden generally. The first line repeats II As 22 = III 4. IV 5. Cf. Fremde 12a; Bauer 10d. e; Herrensuche 3
